correctness.rationale: In the replacement, reversal permits a≤d. Counting zero-, one-, two- and three-one palindrome strings separately gives the stated objective; in the two-one layer the first/third rectangle supplies all rows through i=a (and contains the first/second rectangle), with only the second/third pair supplying further rows. This includes the empty-gap boundaries without counting the empty word. Writing h=d−a, p=b+c, m=min(b,c), t=min(b,h) gives quadratic part Q=a(p+m)+tc and remainder at most 3z+3. For h≥b, reducing h to b at fixed z,b,c can only raise Q, and the two subcases give respectively at most z²/6 and the checked strictly positive certificate for 3z²−16Q. For h≤b the slopes at fixed z,b,c are −b/2 when b≥c and c/2−b when b≤c. The only potentially sharp endpoint is h=0, since the other endpoint is h=b or a=0 (then hc≤z²/8). At h=0, p+m≤3p/2 and 2a+p=z give Q≤3z²/16; equality forces b=c>0, which makes the slope strictly negative and forces h=0, and forces 2a=p. Four balanced gaps achieve the homogeneous maximum. Appending up to three zeros to a balanced integer word gives the claimed matching lower bound to O(z). Continuity on the normalized simplex and the sole homogeneous equality point give rigidity for every maximizing sequence.
residual_risks: Finite program output has not been rerun and is not needed for the all-gap upper bound or rigidity. No exact finite-size maximizer classification is claimed.

evidence: The general run-bounded asymptotic at seven runs is quartic over all lengths of those runs. Fixing three one-runs to singleton length suppresses that top-run term; the published remainder estimate is O(n³), not a sharp bound on the quadratic contributions across run layers.
The primary scattered-palindrome article bounds P by F_{n+2}−1 and considers an extremum at fixed alphabet size rather than fixed multiplicity of a symbol.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither broader feasible set with its looser upper bound determines a sharp upper bound or concentration law for the constrained family.

The broad run bound optimizes its leading run layer and does not control the now-comparable two-one and three-one contributions sharply.

value.rationale: The replacement gives a sharp global answer in a natural sparse-content class and proves that every maximizing word spreads its zeros nearly evenly despite allowing asymmetric placements. The unrestricted upper bound and structural equality case sharpen what the per-word formula or a balanced example can tell a researcher about extremal geometry.
residual_risks: No finite-distance stability modulus, exact formula for the unrestricted integer maximum, or higher-weight classification is established.
